title: The science of English verse
author: Lanier, Sidney
subject: English language -- Versification
Prosody
description: A foundational scientific study of English verse, analyzing rhythm, tune, and color as the three properties of verse. Lanier, himself a musician and poet, argues that verse is governed by the same laws as music.

author: Brewer, Robert Frederick
subject: English language -- Versification
Prosody

author: Ruskin, John
subject: English language -- Versification
Prosody
description: A short pedagogical treatise by John Ruskin setting out the elements of English prosody for school use, with examples drawn from English poets.

author: Guest, Edwin
subject: English language -- Versification
English language -- Rhythm
Prosody
description: The first systematic historical study of English metre, tracing the development of versification from Old English alliterative verse through the introduction of rhyme and syllabic patterns. Enormously influential on subsequent prosodists.

subject: English language -- Versification

subject: English language -- Versification
description: A textbook introduction to English versification for college students, co-authored by James Wilson Bright and Raymond Durbin Miller, covering syllabic, accentual, and quantitative metre.

subject: Blank verse
